-Adds RTL (Right-To-Left) support for all RTL languages -Paragraphs containing RTL text are consistently aligned to the right and text is measured correctly when reshaped -Supports reshaping (connecting) of standard Arabic letters, including Farsi, Kurdish, Turkish and Urdu -Supports reshaping of supplement Arabic letters used in languages such as Farsi and Urdu -Mirroring of symetric symbols such as '(' and ')...

result.reasoning: This commit introduced the isRTLCharacter function with the range (c >= 0xFE70 && c <= 0xFEFF), which incorrectly includes the special unicode marker 0xFEFF as an RTL character. The fix simply narrows the upper bound to 0xFEFE, directly correcting the buggy range introduced in this commit.
